school: 史学（《文献通考》三百四十八卷作者，宋元之际典章制度史与'文''献'考信之学的集大成者）
historical_significance: 马端临（约1225-约1324），字贵与，饶州乐平人，宋末元初史学家，父马廷鸾官至右丞相。'幼承庭训'，得父亲藏书与史学熏染；宋亡后'隐居不仕'，元廷屡起为慈湖、柯山书院山长，晚年出任台州儒学教授——以遗民之身执教于新朝。约自元初起以二十余年之力撰《文献通考》三百四十八卷、二十四门，上承杜佑《通典》、郑樵《通志》而集其大成：'文'（经史会要传记）与'献'（臣僚奏疏诸儒评论）双轨采信、交叉对勘的考信方法，'凡百家传记，但有一说可取者，无不搜罗'的网罗散佚之志，二十四门分目立类、每目内纵贯编年的制度全景架构，'会通因仍'的制度演变谱系学，以及每条按语'明著其所本'的征考体例——使《通考》成为典章制度史的世界性范本（日本、朝鲜半岛长期以'三通'为治史法度）。'凡各门之首，必述其沿革大旨'的总序小序导读体例，是古代知识体系'元目录'设计的完整实践。约大德十一年（1307）前后成书，延祐五年（1318）奏于朝；卒于泰定年间。
historical_significance_en: Ma Duanlin (c. 1225-c. 1324), courtesy name Guiyu, a native of Leping in Raozhou, historian at the Song-Yuan transition, son of Ma Tingluan, chief councilor of the Southern Song. 'Taught by his father from childhood,' steeped in the family library; after the Song's fall he lived 'in retirement refusing office,' though the Yuan court repeatedly made him head of the Cihu and Keshan academies, and late in life instructor of the Confucian school of Taizhou — a loyalist teaching within the new dynasty. Over more than twenty years from the early Yuan he composed the Wenxian Tongkao (Comprehensive Examination of Literature) in 348 juans and twenty-four sections, completing and transcending Du You's Tongdian and Zheng Qiao's Tongzhi: the crediting method of dual tracks — 'wen' (classics, histories, compendia) and 'hsien' (memorials and scholars' judgments) — collated against each other; the ambition of netting the dispersed ('whatever one usable account exists, it is gathered in'); the panoramic architecture of twenty-four topics, each chronicled through the ages; a genealogy of institutional evolution through inheritance and change; and a citation discipline in which every editorial note 'plainly states its basis' — making the Tongkao a world model for the history of institutions, studied as method in Japan and Korea for centuries. Its guiding layer of general and sectional prefaces — 'at the head of each section, the course of its subject' — is the fullest ancient practice of meta-catalog design. Completed around 1307, presented to the throne in 1318; he died in the Taiding years.
unique_thinking: 马端临思维模式的独特性在于'双轨-立目-会通-贻后-导读'五位一体：(1)双轨考信：把'文'（成文典籍）与'献'（在世贤者的奏疏评论）分开采信、交叉对勘、矛盾并存——考信的对象从'哪个说法对'转向'每个说法从何而来'；(2)分目立目：二十四门以制度事项而非典籍为切分单位，每目纵贯两千年——让'有什么'与'缺了什么'同样可见，类目设计本身即是史学立场（象纬物异'记而不解'）；(3)会通因仍：为每项制度建'承袭-改动'的连续谱系，评价单位是链条上的环节而非单点事件——制度演变史的谱系学方法先于现代路径依赖理论七百年；(4)存录以贻后：废料入备考库、已佚之书存其序跋、已废制度完整存录——为不存在的读者保存是档案的第一使命；(5)总序小序导读：在不改动原体系的前提下叠加导读层，'陌生读者可用'成为知识体系组织的完成标准。网罗散佚的征集面公平、文木去伪的可信度标注、各录其旧后断己意的冲突处理、明著所本的征考体例，共同构成一个把亡国经验转化为普遍方法的完整思维体系。
unique_thinking_en: The uniqueness of Ma Duanlin's thinking is a pentad of dual tracks, topical division, concourse-with-inheritance, preservation-for-later, and the guiding layer. (1) Dual-track crediting: 'wen' (written records) and 'hsien' (living testimony) credited separately, collated across, contradictions preserved — the object of criticism shifts from 'which account is right' to 'where each account came from.' (2) Division by topic: twenty-four sections cut along institutional matters rather than books, each spanning two millennia — making 'what is there' and 'what is missing' equally visible; the taxonomy itself a historiographic stance (omens 'recorded, not interpreted'). (3) Concourse and inheritance: a continuous genealogy of each institution's continuities and amendments, the unit of evaluation the link in a chain, not the single event — a genealogy of institutional change seven centuries before path-dependence theory. (4) Preserving for those who come after: discards into a reserve repository, lost books kept through their prefaces, abolished institutions recorded in full — saving for readers who do not yet exist is the archive's first duty. (5) The guiding layer: general and sectional prefaces overlaid on an untouched system, 'stranger usability' the completed standard of organization. The fairness of the collecting net, the credibility tags of textual criticism, the record-each-first-then-judge handling of conflict, and the citation discipline of stating every basis complete a system that turned the experience of a dynasty's fall into universal method.
civilization_zh: 宋末元初的饶州与江南：生于饶州乐平（约1225），父马廷鸾自秘书省累计迁至右丞相兼枢密使（1267-1273 在任），家藏书富；咸淳九年（1273）父因与贾似道不合罢相；德祐二年（1276）元兵入临安，宋亡——马端临从此隐居乡里，以宋遗民自处；元廷先后起用其为慈湖书院、柯山书院山长，又出任台州儒学教授，约二十年间以'在野之身'完成《文献通考》（约1285-1307）；延祐五年（1318）由学官奏于朝，诏令刊行；约卒于泰定元年（1324）——其一生横跨宋亡前后的半个世纪，与黄震、金履祥等遗民学者同处一个'以著述存文献'的时代
civilization_en: Raozhou and Jiangnan at the Song-Yuan transition: born in Leping, Raozhou (c. 1225), his father Ma Tingluan rising through the Palace Library to chief councilor (1267-1273), the family library rich; in 1273 the father resigned, at odds with Jia Sidao; in 1276 the Yuan army entered Lin'an and the Song fell — Ma Duanlin thenceforth lived in retirement as a Song loyalist; the Yuan court made him head of the Cihu and then the Keshan academy, and instructor of the Taizhou Confucian school, while over some twenty years 'from outside office' he completed the Wenxian Tongkao (c. 1285-1307); in 1318 it was presented to the throne by court scholars and ordered printed; he died around 1324 — a life spanning the half century of the fall, contemporary with loyalist scholars like Huang Zhen and Jin Lüxiang in an age that 'preserved the documents through writing'

cross_references.description_zh: 马端临与司马迁相隔一千三百年而同守'网罗放失旧闻'之志：太史公'厥协六经异传，整齐百家杂语'确立多源采信的史家原型，马端临'凡百家传记，但有一说可取者，无不搜罗'把这一征集面推向典章制度史的极限——一个以人物列传存文明，一个以制度条目存文明；《史记》的'网罗'是抢救性收集，马端临的'网罗'是系统化征考，从天才的直觉到可传承的体例，正是史学方法成熟的两级台阶。
cross_references.description_en: A millennium and three centuries apart, Ma Duanlin kept faith with Sima Qian's ambition of 'netting the lost tales of the realm': the Grand Historian's 'concord of the six schools' and 'ordering of the hundred schools' set the archetype of multi-source collection, and Ma's 'whatever one usable account exists, it is gathered in' pushed that collecting net to the limits of institutional history — one preserving civilization through lives, the other through institutional entries; Sima Qian's netting was rescue gathering, Ma's was systematic examination: from genius's intuition to transmissible format, the two steps of historiography's maturing.

cross_references.description_zh: 马端临与黄宗羲同为王朝倾覆后的'存文献者'而路径互补：黄宗羲以《明儒学案》存一代学脉、以'学案体'为思想立传，马端临以《文献通考》存一代典章、以'分目立类'为制度立谱——一个存'人'与'学'，一个存'制'与'事'；两人都拒仕新朝而以著述为遗民之业，都以'会通'对治断代之偏；学案体的'序录-学案-附录'三层与通考的'总序-小序-按语'三层，是同一导读设计在思想史与制度史中的两个完成态。
cross_references.description_en: Ma Duanlin and Huang Zongxi, both 'preservers of documents' after a dynasty's fall, took complementary paths: Huang saved a generation's intellectual lineage in the Mingru Xue'an, writing biography for thought with the xue'an format; Ma saved a generation's institutions in the Wenxian Tongkao, writing genealogy for governance with topical division — one preserving 'persons and learning,' the other 'institutions and affairs'; both refused the new dynasty, making writing their loyalist vocation, both countering dynastic fragmentariness with concourse; the xue'an's three layers (survey, cases, appendix) and the Tongkao's three layers (general preface, sectional prefaces, editorial notes) are the same guiding design completed in intellectual and institutional history.

cross_references.description_zh: 马端临与沈括同出两宋而方向相反：沈括以《梦溪笔谈》把'见闻'写成百科——现象与技艺的即时记录者；马端临以《文献通考》把'记录'织成体系——典章与制度的长时段织工；一个信'亲验'（以实验与勘测修正文本），一个信'征考'（以出处与对勘修正传闻）；沈括代表宋代知识文化的'横向博物'，马端临代表其'纵向通考'——两者合观，方见两宋知识工程的完整光谱：从记录一切到贯通一切。
cross_references.description_en: Both of the Song world yet moving in opposite directions: Shen Kuo's Brush Talks wrote 'what was seen and heard' into an encyclopedia — an instant recorder of phenomena and techniques; Ma Duanlin's Tongkao wove 'what was recorded' into a system — a long-duration weaver of institutions and governance; one trusted 'personal verification' (correcting texts by experiment and survey), the other 'documentary examination' (correcting hearsay by provenance and collation); Shen Kuo is Song knowledge culture's horizontal natural history, Ma Duanlin its vertical comprehensive examination — together they span the full spectrum of the Song knowledge enterprise, from recording everything to connecting everything.

cross_references.description_zh: 马端临的对象纬、物异门的处理与王充《论衡》的疾虚妄一脉相承：王充把灾祥从'天谴'还原为'自然之变'，马端临在象纬、物异门'记其事而不附会其义'——记录与解释分轨，超验叙事被降格为待考条目；两人相隔千余年而共享同一史学立场：史官的职责是存真，不是证道；这一'记录不解'的体例设计，使《通考》的类目架构本身成为理性化的标本。
cross_references.description_en: Ma Duanlin's handling of the astrology and anomalies sections descends from Wang Chong's campaign against the false in the Lunheng: Wang Chong restored omens from 'heavenly chastisement' to 'natural change,' and Ma Duanlin in the xiangwei and wuyi sections 'recorded the event without appending the meaning' — record and interpretation on separate tracks, transcendent narrative demoted to entries pending examination; a millennium apart they share one historiographic stance: the historian's duty is to preserve the true, not to prove the Way; this 'record without interpreting' format makes the Tongkao's very architecture a specimen of rationalization.

modes.name_en: The Method of Dual-Track Documentary Evidence
modes.domain_zh: 史料分'文'与'献'两轨采信：文是成文的典籍记录，献是贤者的口述见闻——两轨分开标注、交叉对勘，矛盾不删而并存存证——考信的对象不是'哪个说法对'，而是'每个说法从何而来'
modes.domain_en: Sources are credited on two tracks, wen and hsien: wen the written records, hsien the testimony of the living and informed — tracked separately, cross-collated, contradictions preserved side by side rather than deleted; what is examined is not 'which account is right' but 'where each account came from'
modes.definition_zh: 史料分'文'与'献'两轨采信：文是成文的典籍记录，献是贤者的口述见闻——两轨分开标注、交叉对勘，矛盾不删而并存存证——考信的对象不是'哪个说法对'，而是'每个说法从何而来'
modes.definition_en: Sources are credited on two tracks, wen and hsien: wen the written records, hsien the testimony of the living and informed — tracked separately, cross-collated, contradictions preserved side by side rather than deleted; what is examined is not 'which account is right' but 'where each account came from'
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡叙事则本之经史，而参之以历代会要以及百家传记之书
modes.key_quote_en: 'For narrative I take the classics and histories as the base, cross-checking the dynastic compendia and the hundred schools of biography.'
process_zh: 先立来源等级表：经史为上、会要次之、传记又次之——每条史料入库时先定其等级，而不先定其真伪
文与献分轨标注：成文记录与口述见闻分别立档，采信规则各自独立——两类证据不因形式混同
交叉对勘：同一事实在两轨中的记载互相核对——分歧即研究对象而非待清除的噪音
矛盾并存存证：两说不下时并列记录、注明'两说并存'——考信的诚实在于保留分歧而非强行裁决
process_en: Establish a source hierarchy first: classics and histories above compendia, biographies below — each source graded on entry, before any judgment of truth
Tag the two tracks separately: written records and oral testimony filed apart, credited under independent rules — the two kinds of evidence are never blended by form
Collate across tracks: records of the same fact in both tracks checked against each other — divergence is the object of study, not noise to be cleaned

Preserve contradictions as evidence: where two accounts cannot be decided, record both with a note 'two accounts coexist' — honesty in textual criticism means keeping the disagreement, not forcing a verdict
representative_cases_zh: 《文献通考》自序对'文''献'的界定与全书采信规则：马端临自释'文'为经史会要传记之书、'献'为臣僚奏疏诸儒评论——名'文''献'而考其来源
《经籍考》对每书存录原书序跋与历代评语的体例：让读者亲见历代之'献'
对《通典》《通志》的批判性继承：杜佑、郑樵之说被全文存录并标注异同
representative_cases_en: The preface's own definition of wen and hsien and the book's crediting rules: Ma Duanlin explains 'wen' as the classics, histories and compendia, 'hsien' as memorials and scholars' judgments — the name itself a theory of sources
The Jingji Kao's format of preserving prefaces and历代 evaluations for each book: letting readers see the 'hsien' of every age with their own eyes
Critical inheritance from the Tongdian and Tongzhi: Du You's and Zheng Qiao's views recorded in full with differences marked
modern_applications_zh: 企业知识库的来源分级与'两说并存'标注：矛盾事实不删除而并列存证
司法证据制度的'两造并存'：判决书存录双方证据与采信理由
开源软件的多源考据：依赖出处、许可证、维护者证言分开采信
modern_applications_en: Enterprise knowledge bases with source grading and 'two accounts coexist' annotations: contradictory facts preserved, not deleted
Judicial evidence systems recording both sides and the reasons for crediting either
Multi-source verification in open-source software: provenance, license and maintainer testimony credited separately
representative_figures: 马端临（核心）
司马迁（源头：'厥协六经异传，整齐百家杂语'——多源采信的史家原型）
兰克（跨文明平行：'如实直书'与史料批判——同题的十九世纪德国回答）
王国维（平行：'二重证据法'——纸上与地下两轨对勘的现代重述）

modes.name_en: The Method of Topical Division and Class Establishment
modes.domain_zh: 典章制度的知识按'目'立类而非按'书'抄撮：田赋、钱币、职役、征榷、市籴、土贡、国用、选举、学校、职官、郊社、宗庙、王礼、乐、兵、刑、经籍、帝系、封建、象纬、物异——二十四目纵贯古今，让'有什么'与'缺了什么'同样可见
modes.domain_en: Institutional knowledge is organized by topics, not excerpted by book: land-tax, coinage, corvée, revenues, markets, tribute, expenditure, selection, schools, offices, sacrifice, ancestral temple, royal ritual, music, military, punishment, bibliography, imperial lineage, enfeoffment, astrology, anomalies — twenty-four topics spanning all ages, making 'what is there' and 'what is missing' equally visible
modes.definition_zh: 典章制度的知识按'目'立类而非按'书'抄撮：田赋、钱币、职役、征榷、市籴、土贡、国用、选举、学校、职官、郊社、宗庙、王礼、乐、兵、刑、经籍、帝系、封建、象纬、物异——二十四目纵贯古今，让'有什么'与'缺了什么'同样可见
modes.definition_en: Institutional knowledge is organized by topics, not excerpted by book: land-tax, coinage, corvée, revenues, markets, tribute, expenditure, selection, schools, offices, sacrifice, ancestral temple, royal ritual, music, military, punishment, bibliography, imperial lineage, enfeoffment, astrology, anomalies — twenty-four topics spanning all ages, making 'what is there' and 'what is missing' equally visible
modes.source_chapter: 《文献通考》全书二十四门体例
modes.key_quote_zh: 采经史传注，分为二十四门
modes.key_quote_en: 'Drawing on classics, histories, commentaries and sub-commentaries, arranged in twenty-four sections.'
process_zh: 按事项立目而不按典籍立目：类目切分以'制度事项'为单位（田赋、钱币、职官……）——同一事项的古今材料聚于一目
每目内部纵贯编年：一目之内按朝代顺序铺陈材料——类是横的骨架，时是纵的血脉
标注缺载：某代某目无材料时明确标'缺'或'无考'——空白被制度化为可见条目而非沉默
以目为检索单位：使用者按制度事项检索而非按原书检索——分类为使用场景服务而非为文献美学服务
process_en: Divide by subject matter, not by book: classes cut along institutional topics (land-tax, coinage, offices...) — all ages' material on one topic gathered under one heading
Chronicle within each topic: inside a section materials laid out dynasty by dynasty — class the horizontal frame, time the vertical blood
Annotate gaps: when a topic has no material for a reign, mark 'missing' or 'unverifiable' explicitly — blankness institutionalized as a visible entry, not silence
Make the topic the retrieval unit: users search by institutional matter, not by source book — classification serves the use-case, not bibliographic aesthetics
representative_cases_zh: 二十四门对《通典》九门的扩容与对《通志》二十略的取舍：马端临在两大家之间的立类自觉
《经籍考》单列成门：文献目录本身成为一级类目——元数据升格为制度知识
象纬、物异两门的处理：把灾异从'天谴叙事'降为'记录条目'——类目设计本身就是史学立场
representative_cases_en: The expansion of the Tongdian's nine sections into twenty-four, and the choices among the Tongzhi's twenty treatises: Ma Duanlin's conscious class-making between two masters
The Jingji Kao as a section of its own: bibliography itself a first-class topic — metadata promoted to institutional knowledge
The handling of astrology and anomalies: omens demoted from 'heavenly chastisement narrative' to 'recorded entries' — the taxonomy itself a historiographic stance
modern_applications_zh: 数据仓库的主题域建模：按业务事项而非按源系统立目——分目立类的工程版
政府规章数据库的'事项检索'：按管理事项切分而非按发文机关
个人知识库的 PARA 与 Johnny.Decimal：按'可检索'而非'文献完备'设计类目
modern_applications_en: Data-warehouse subject-area modeling: topics cut by business matter, not by source system — topical division as engineering
Regulation databases searched by administrative matter rather than issuing agency
PARA and Johnny.Decimal in personal knowledge management: classes designed for retrieval, not bibliographic completeness
representative_figures: 马端临（核心）
杜佑（上游：《通典》九门——政书体的开创者）
郑樵（上游：《通志》二十略——'会通'观的提出者）
林奈（跨文明平行：生物分类的目科属种——同构的分类雄心）

modes.name_en: The Method of Concourse and Inheritance-Tracing
modes.domain_zh: 制度的理解必须贯通其'因'与'变'：'会通'要求把一项制度两千年间的承袭与改动作成连续谱系——每一现行形态都向上链接它所修改的旧形态——'不读因仍之迹，无以会通其变'
modes.domain_en: Institutions must be understood through their inheritance and change: 'concurrence' demands a continuous genealogy of each institution's continuities and amendments across two millennia — every current form linked upward to the older forms it modified; 'without reading the traces of inheritance, there is no grasping the change'
modes.definition_zh: 制度的理解必须贯通其'因'与'变'：'会通'要求把一项制度两千年间的承袭与改动作成连续谱系——每一现行形态都向上链接它所修改的旧形态——'不读因仍之迹，无以会通其变'
modes.definition_en: Institutions must be understood through their inheritance and change: 'concurrence' demands a continuous genealogy of each institution's continuities and amendments across two millennia — every current form linked upward to the older forms it modified; 'without reading the traces of inheritance, there is no grasping the change'
modes.key_quote_zh: 《通志》之病在不间断代而求会通，然会通之法固善
modes.key_quote_en: 'The method of concourse is sound in itself.'
process_zh: 为每项制度建演变链：从该制度的最早形态起，逐代标注承袭了什么（因）、改动了什么（变）——谱系先于评价
区分'名异实同'与'名同实异'：唐代两税与上古赋税名目不同而功能相承，某制名目依旧而实质已变——判断必须落在功能层
把变革置于前因中评价：一项改制不是孤立的'进步'或'倒退'，而是对前代困境的回应——评价单位是'链条上的环节'而非'单点事件'
以会通断代：通贯的视野用来照亮某一时代，而非取代断代的深耕——会通服务于理解，不服务于铺陈
process_en: Build an evolution chain for each institution: from its earliest form, dynasty by dynasty, mark what is inherited and what is altered — genealogy before evaluation

Distinguish 'same name, same reality' from 'name inherited, reality changed': Tang's two-tax system differs in name from ancient levies yet continues their function; some institutions keep their name while their substance has fled — judgment must land on the functional level

Evaluate change within its antecedents: a reform is not an isolated 'progress' or 'decline' but an answer to the previous age's predicament — the unit of evaluation is the link in a chain, not a single event
Use concourse to light a reign: the through-line of two millennia illuminates one dynasty rather than replacing close reading of it — concourse serves understanding, not display
representative_cases_zh: 田赋门对两千年赋役制度的连续谱系：从三代贡助彻到两税法到一条鞭的'因-变'标注
钱币门对币制的长时段追踪：五铢钱七百年承袭与历代改铸的因果链
自序对杜佑、郑樵的取舍：'会通'之义取自郑樵，而讥其'以裁断为主'——方法论自觉的传承
representative_cases_en: The land-tax section's continuous genealogy of two millennia: from the Three Dynasties' tribute-aid-share, through the two-tax law, to the single-whip reform, each link marked inherit-or-change
The coinage section's long tracking of currency: the seven-century continuity of the wuzhu coin and the causal chain of successive remintings
The preface's stance toward Du You and Zheng Qiao: taking 'concurrence' from Zheng Qiao while criticizing his 'judgment-first' — methodological inheritance made explicit
modern_applications_zh: 制度经济学的'路径依赖'分析：诺思对制度演变链的量化——会通因仍的现代版本
法律判例的演变链工具：KeyCite/Shepard's 引证追踪——判例制度的历史谱系化
企业流程的'变更史'管理：每个现行流程可回溯其历次修订及修订理由
modern_applications_en: Path dependence in institutional economics: North's quantified evolution chains — inheritance-tracing modernized
Case-law evolution tools like KeyCite and Shepard's: legal precedent turned into traced genealogy
Change-history management in enterprise process: every current process traceable through its amendments and their reasons
representative_figures: 马端临（核心）
郑樵（源头：《通志》'会通'之义——因仍法的直接提出者）
杜佑（上游：《通典》的政书纵贯——会通的先行实践）
诺思（跨文明平行：制度变迁的路径依赖——同一洞见的经济学化）

modes.name_en: The Method of Netting the Dispersed Sources
modes.domain_zh: 在场的显赫者的声音会淹没不在场的多数：'网罗散佚'把证据征集的面从'易于取得的权威文本'扩展到'散落于笔记、奏疏、方志、序跋中的边缘记载'——史料的公平来自征集面的公平
modes.domain_en: The voices of the present and eminent drown out the absent many: 'netting the dispersed' widens evidence-gathering from the easily reached authoritative texts to marginal records scattered in notebooks, memorials, gazetteers and colophons — fairness of the evidence pool comes from fairness of the gathering net
modes.definition_zh: 在场的显赫者的声音会淹没不在场的多数：'网罗散佚'把证据征集的面从'易于取得的权威文本'扩展到'散落于笔记、奏疏、方志、序跋中的边缘记载'——史料的公平来自征集面的公平
modes.definition_en: The voices of the present and eminent drown out the absent many: 'netting the dispersed' widens evidence-gathering from the easily reached authoritative texts to marginal records scattered in notebooks, memorials, gazetteers and colophons — fairness of the evidence pool comes from fairness of the gathering net
modes.source_chapter: 《文献通考》引书范围（《经籍考》《经籍门》辑录体）
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡百家传记，但有一说可取者，无不搜罗
modes.key_quote_en: 'Whatever the hundred schools of biography hold, if a single usable account exists, it is gathered in.'
process_zh: 先定'可采'标准而非'权威'标准：但凡有一说可取即入网——采信层级后置，收集门槛前移
辑录并存：同一问题诸家说法并录原文而不先行裁断——让读者面对证据全集而非编者的残本
显赫与边缘同权入网：正史与笔记、奏疏与方志同一标准收录——史料的地位由内容决定而非由载体决定
标注出处与卷次：每条辑录注明书名篇卷——散佚材料的可信度靠出处而非靠名气支撑
process_en: Set the criterion as 'usable,' not 'authoritative': anything with one usable account enters the net — the threshold moves to collection, the hierarchy deferred to crediting
Record rival accounts side by side: on any question the several schools' original texts are compiled without prior adjudication — readers face the full evidence, not the editor's residue
Eminent and marginal enter on equal terms: standard histories and notebooks, memorials and gazetteers gathered under one standard — a source's standing set by content, not carrier
Cite source and juan: every excerpt noted by title and chapter — the credibility of dispersed material rests on its provenance, not its fame
representative_cases_zh: 《经籍考》的辑录体实践：每书之下存录历代序跋评语数十条，朱彝尊称其'采摭宏富'——辑佚书目成为后世辑佚工作的渊薮
田赋、职役诸门对地方性材料的采用：方志、民谣、俗谚与正史并列
自序明言对马贵与'网罗'的自信：'凡百家传记，但有一说可取者，无不搜罗'
representative_cases_en: The jilu format of the Jingji Kao: dozens of prefaces and evaluations preserved under each title — later scholars' hui-yi (recovery of lost texts) work drawing from this wellspring
The use of local materials in the land-tax and corvée sections: gazetteers, ballads and proverbs set beside the standard histories
The preface's own confidence in netting: 'whatever one usable account exists, it is gathered in'
modern_applications_zh: 口述史与民间档案计划：把'非正式记忆者'纳入档案征集面
开放同行评议与'红队'机制：征集'不在场的批评者'而非圈内互捧
eDiscovery 与全量取证：证据保全从'指定渠道'扩展到'全量网罗'
modern_applications_en: Oral history and vernacular archives: informal rememberers brought into the collecting net
Open peer review and red-team mechanisms: soliciting the absent critics rather than in-circle praise
eDiscovery and full-scope preservation: evidence collection widened from designated channels to the whole field
representative_figures: 马端临（核心）
司马光（上游：《资治通鉴考异》对异说的并存考订——网罗异说的先行者）
裴松之（源头：《三国志注》'鸠集传记，增广异闻'——注中存史的传统）
斯科特（平行：《国家的视角》对'官方档案盲区'的揭示——边缘史料的人类学版）

modes.name_en: The Method of Setting Apart the True and the Suspicious
modes.domain_zh: 对入录的每条史料做真伪与可信度的独立标注：不得以文本之美、说法之盛代替证据之实——'存疑'不是失败而是成果——标注不确知，比假装确知更能积累信任
modes.domain_en: Every source entering the record carries an independent mark of authenticity and credibility: the beauty of a text or the popularity of a story never substitutes for the weight of evidence — 'doubt reserved' is not failure but result; marking what you do not know earns more trust than pretending you do
modes.definition_zh: 对入录的每条史料做真伪与可信度的独立标注：不得以文本之美、说法之盛代替证据之实——'存疑'不是失败而是成果——标注不确知，比假装确知更能积累信任
modes.definition_en: Every source entering the record carries an independent mark of authenticity and credibility: the beauty of a text or the popularity of a story never substitutes for the weight of evidence — 'doubt reserved' is not failure but result; marking what you do not know earns more trust than pretending you do
modes.source_chapter: 《文献通考》考辨条目与《经籍考》对伪书的处理
modes.key_quote_en: 'Where things are doubtful, one may not fail to examine.'
process_zh: 逐条独立考辨：每条史料单独核定真伪与等级，不因'全书大体可信'而连带采信——可信度不传染
标注存疑而非删除：可疑材料保留并加'疑''传闻''无考'标签——存疑条目是研究路标而非废弃物
区分'事实'与'评价'：叙事（发生了什么）与评论（当时代怎么看）分轨记录——价值判断不得伪装成事实陈述
对显赫来源同样下手：正史、经典、名人之言同受考辨——权威性豁免是考信的第一漏洞
process_en: Examine each item independently: every source graded for authenticity on its own, never credited by the general reliability of its host work — credibility does not contagion
Mark doubts, never delete: suspicious material kept with tags 'doubtful,' 'hearsay,' 'unverifiable' — doubted entries are waymarkers, not waste
Separate fact from valuation: narrative (what happened) and commentary (how the age judged it) recorded on separate tracks — value judgments may not masquerade as fact
Apply the same blade to eminent sources: standard histories, classics and famous names examined alike — authority exemption is the first breach of textual criticism
representative_cases_zh: 《经籍考》对诸书真伪的历代辨说并存：伪书之说与辩护之说并录——存疑而非定谳
象纬、物异门对灾异记录的'异而不解'处理：记其事而不附会其义
对《通典》《通志》两书中可疑条目的删削与标注：批判性继承的直接证据
representative_cases_en: The Jingji Kao's co-preservation of authentication disputes for each title: forgery claims and defenses recorded together — doubt reserved, verdict withheld
The astrology and anomalies sections' 'record without interpreting': the event entered, the omen-reading not appended
Deletions and annotations applied to suspect passages of the Tongdian and Tongzhi: direct evidence of critical inheritance
modern_applications_zh: 数据科学的'数据溯源卡'：每个数据集标注来源、清洗史与已知偏差
新闻事实核查的分级系统（真/存疑/假）：存疑作为独立等级而非删稿
软件依赖审计：SBOM 清单逐件标注已知漏洞与可信度
modern_applications_en: Data provenance cards in data science: every dataset tagged with source, cleaning history and known bias
Fact-checking grade systems (true / disputed / false): 'disputed' as a standing grade rather than deletion
Software dependency audits: SBOM entries individually marked with known vulnerabilities and trust level
representative_figures: 马端临（核心）
崔述（后世平行：《考信录》把考辨发展为独立学科——同一方法论的清代言明）
刘知几（源头：《史通》'疑古''惑经'——史料批判的唐代宣言）
波普尔（跨文明平行：可证伪性作为知识标准——存疑的制度化）

modes.name_en: The Method of Preserving for Those Who Come After
modes.domain_zh: 档案的第一使命不是当下使用而是'贻后'：被舍弃的材料不销毁而入备考库——今天'无用'的草稿、口述、废案，正是后人复原时代细节的唯一来源——为不存在的读者保存
modes.domain_en: The archive's first duty is not present use but preservation for those who come after: discarded materials are not destroyed but shelved in reserve — today's 'useless' drafts, testimony and dead proposals are tomorrow's only source for recovering an age's fine detail — saving for readers who do not yet exist
modes.definition_zh: 档案的第一使命不是当下使用而是'贻后'：被舍弃的材料不销毁而入备考库——今天'无用'的草稿、口述、废案，正是后人复原时代细节的唯一来源——为不存在的读者保存
modes.definition_en: The archive's first duty is not present use but preservation for those who come after: discarded materials are not destroyed but shelved in reserve — today's 'useless' drafts, testimony and dead proposals are tomorrow's only source for recovering an age's fine detail — saving for readers who do not yet exist
modes.source_chapter: 《文献通考·自序》及历代文献存录实践
modes.key_quote_en: 'Saving one in ten from a thousand and a hundred.'
process_zh: 把'舍弃'改为'归档'：编纂或整理过程中被淘汰的材料统一编号入库而非销毁——淘汰决定可逆，销毁不可逆
按'来源地'保存而非按'用途'保存：备考库按材料出处组织，不按当前用途分类——用途会变，出处不变
标注取舍理由：每份入备考库的材料注明为何被舍弃——后人看到的不是残片而是'带落选理由的候选者'
接受冗余成本：为极低概率的未来用途付出当下存储与整理成本——文明的记忆建立在冗余之上
process_en: Turn 'discard' into 'archive': materials eliminated during compilation are numbered into a reserve repository rather than destroyed — a selection decision is reversible; destruction is not
Organize the reserve by provenance, not by present use: the reserve filed by where material came from, not what it is currently for — uses change, provenance does not
Annotate the reason for setting aside: every reserved item carries a note of why it was excluded — posterity sees candidates with their reasons for rejection, not fragments
Accept redundancy cost: pay today's storage and curation cost for a low-probability future use — civilization's memory is built on redundancy
representative_cases_zh: 《经籍考》对已佚之书的存目与辑录：书亡而序跋存——后世辑佚由此入手
田赋诸门对已废制度的完整存录：废弃的制度被作为历史事实保留而非抹去——'废'本身是制度史的一部分
自序'存十一于千百'的自觉：马端临深知所存者稀，故凡可得者皆存
representative_cases_en: The Jingji Kao's preservation of lost books through their prefaces and entries: the book gone, the colophons remain — later text-recovery starting here
The complete recording of abolished institutions in the land-tax sections: defunct systems kept as historical fact, not erased — 'abolished' itself part of institutional history
The preface's awareness of 'saving one in ten from a thousand and a hundred': knowing how little survives, everything obtainable is kept
modern_applications_zh: 软件版本的'废弃但保留'策略：deprecated API 不立即删除而保留迁移文档
机构档案的'休眠档案'制度：不再流转的档案入休眠库而非销毁
个人数据的时间胶囊：按'未来研究者视角'而非'当下整理美学'决定保留
modern_applications_en: Deprecated-but-retained strategies in software: old APIs kept with migration docs instead of deleted
Dormant-archive regimes in institutions: records no longer circulating shelved, not destroyed
Personal time capsules: retention decided from the future researcher's view, not today's tidiness
representative_figures: 马端临（核心）
司马迁（源头：'网罗天下放失旧闻'——为后世存史的史家原型）
亚历山大图书馆（平行：以'存一切'为宗旨的文明记忆工程）
维基媒体基金会（平行：'每个编辑版本永久保留'——冗余存档的现代制度化）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Comprehensive Scholar
modes.domain_zh: 专精之学与会通之学分工不同而互相成就：'通儒'不做每一领域的专家，而做把诸领域接通的人——把田赋与钱币、学校与选举放在同一张桌上，制度间的隐含联系才显形
modes.domain_en: Specialist learning and comprehensive learning divide the labor and complete each other: the 'comprehensive scholar' is not expert in every field but the one who connects the fields — placing land-tax beside coinage, schools beside selection on one table, until the implicit ties between institutions become visible
modes.definition_zh: 专精之学与会通之学分工不同而互相成就：'通儒'不做每一领域的专家，而做把诸领域接通的人——把田赋与钱币、学校与选举放在同一张桌上，制度间的隐含联系才显形
modes.definition_en: Specialist learning and comprehensive learning divide the labor and complete each other: the 'comprehensive scholar' is not expert in every field but the one who connects the fields — placing land-tax beside coinage, schools beside selection on one table, until the implicit ties between institutions become visible
modes.key_quote_zh: 学者之当务，盖将不泥古而不戾今
modes.key_quote_en: 'Neither clinging to antiquity nor violating the present.'
process_zh: 以'接通'为目标而非以'覆盖'为目标：通儒之学不追求知晓一切，而追求让领域间彼此可见——联系先于完备
在类目之间预留接口：二十四门之间设置互见与参见——分类不是孤立的抽屉而是相扣的环
以当代问题为接通点：'不泥古而不戾今'——会通的落点是对当世的解释与建议，而非古物的铺陈
承认专精的优先地位：通儒引用专家成果并注明出处，不僭越专业判断——会通是综合而非替代
process_en: Aim at connection, not coverage: comprehensive learning seeks not to know everything but to make fields visible to one another — connection precedes completeness
Build interfaces between categories: cross-references among the twenty-four sections — classes not isolated drawers but interlocking rings
Use contemporary questions as the junction: 'neither clinging to antiquity nor violating the present' — concourse lands on explanation and counsel for the age, not display of antiquities
Honor specialist priority: the comprehensive scholar cites experts with provenance and never overrules professional judgment — concourse is synthesis, not substitution
representative_cases_zh: 田赋门与职官门、学校门与选举门的互见设计：制度间的联动（如养士之费与赋税之入）在门间接通处显形
自序对'一以为取士之方，一以为牧民之具'的双重定位：知识整合直接服务于治国实务
对'断代为史'局限的超越：不替代断代深耕，而以贯通之光照亮单代
representative_cases_en: The cross-references linking land-tax to offices, schools to selection: institutional couplings (the cost of supporting scholars against the intake of taxes) surfacing at the joints between sections
The preface's dual framing — 'one as the method of selecting men, one as the tool of governing the people': knowledge integration in direct service of statecraft
Transcending the limitation of dynasty-by-dynasty history: not replacing close reading but lighting each reign with the through-line
modern_applications_zh: 跨学科研究所的'接口岗'：不新增专业而设'领域间联络'职位
企业的'架构师'角色：不替代领域专家而负责领域间接通
智库报告的'综合判断'章节：引用各领域专家、注明出处、只做接通
modern_applications_en: Interface roles in interdisciplinary institutes: liaison positions adding connection rather than new specialties
The enterprise architect: not replacing domain experts but wiring the domains together
A think tank's synthesis chapter: citing each field's experts with provenance, doing only the connecting
representative_figures: 马端临（核心）
郑樵（源头：《通志》'总天下之大学术'——通儒理想的直接宣言）
杜佑（上游：《通典》以食货为先的通贯设计——接通的先行者）
怀特海（跨文明平行：'专业化的代价是整体感的丧失'——对通儒之学的现代辩护）

modes.name_en: The Method of Record Each First, Judge After
modes.domain_zh: 面对冲突的多个传统或体系，先各自完整存录、再断以己意：裁决被推迟到'双方都以自己的最强形式被呈现'之后——被记录者得到的是公平呈现，而非同情
modes.domain_en: Facing conflicting traditions or systems, record each in full first, then judge with your own mind: adjudication is deferred until both sides are presented in their strongest form — what is recorded receives fair presentation, not sympathy
modes.definition_zh: 面对冲突的多个传统或体系，先各自完整存录、再断以己意：裁决被推迟到'双方都以自己的最强形式被呈现'之后——被记录者得到的是公平呈现，而非同情
modes.definition_en: Facing conflicting traditions or systems, record each in full first, then judge with your own mind: adjudication is deferred until both sides are presented in their strongest form — what is recorded receives fair presentation, not sympathy
modes.source_chapter: 《文献通考》对典章流变的处理体例（杜佑、郑樵之说先录后评）
modes.key_quote_zh: 各录其旧，而后断以己意
modes.key_quote_en: 'Record each tradition intact; then judge with your own mind.'
process_zh: 先完整存录各方：冲突的传统按其自身逻辑完整成文——存录标准是'其最强形式'而非'可轻易驳倒的稻草人'
逐条标注同异：两套体系的每一条对照标注'同''异'与'异在何处'——分歧被精确制图而非笼统对立
推迟裁决到地图完成之后：在全部异同标注完成前不做任何裁决——裁决的质量受制于地图的精度
只在真互斥处断以己意：同处不裁决（并存），异处可并存者并存（注记），唯真互斥者由编者裁断——裁决被压缩到最小面
process_en: Record each in full first: conflicting traditions written up completely on their own logic — the standard of recording is their strongest form, never a strawman
Map agreements and differences item by item: every clause of the two systems annotated 'same,' 'different,' and 'differing thus' — divergence precisely cartographed, not loosely opposed
Defer adjudication until the map is done: no ruling before the full annotation of agreements and differences — the quality of judgment is bounded by the precision of the map

Judge only the genuinely exclusive: where they agree, no ruling (both stand); where they differ but can coexist, note the coexistence; the editor rules only on true exclusions — adjudication compressed to a minimum surface
representative_cases_zh: 对杜佑《通典》与郑樵《通志》的处理：两书之说先全文存录、再于按语中标注取舍——'各录其旧后断己意'的方法论示范
二十四门中对前代诸家评论的并存体例：诸儒之说并录而不先行站队
自序对《通典》《通志》得失的总评：先历数两家之功，再总断其'得'与'病'
representative_cases_en: The handling of the Tongdian and Tongzhi: both works recorded in full, the compiler's selection annotated in commentary — the method demonstrated on his two masters
The co-preservation of earlier scholars' judgments across the twenty-four sections: schools recorded side by side without prior alignment
The preface's overall verdict on the two masters' merits and failings: first enumerating each achievement, then judging

modes.name_en: The Method of Documentary Examination and Accountability
modes.category: 推理方法论/可审计论证
modes.domain_zh: 论证的可信度来自'可按图索骥'：把每个结论的依据写成可公开核检的征考文档——出处、取舍、排除项一并列明——审计者从'与作者对峙'变为'沿图核检'——偏见藏在'没有说明'里
modes.domain_en: An argument's credibility comes from being checkable: every conclusion's grounds written into a publicly inspectable examination document — provenance, choices and exclusions all listed; the auditor turns from confronting the author to following the map — bias hides in what was never explained
modes.definition_zh: 论证的可信度来自'可按图索骥'：把每个结论的依据写成可公开核检的征考文档——出处、取舍、排除项一并列明——审计者从'与作者对峙'变为'沿图核检'——偏见藏在'没有说明'里
modes.definition_en: An argument's credibility comes from being checkable: every conclusion's grounds written into a publicly inspectable examination document — provenance, choices and exclusions all listed; the auditor turns from confronting the author to following the map — bias hides in what was never explained
modes.source_chapter: 《文献通考》按语体例与《经籍考》引证规范
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡所考订，皆明著其所本
modes.key_quote_en: 'Whatever is examined, its basis is plainly stated.'
process_zh: 每个结论附依据清单：结论与出处一一对应（'明著其所本'）——无出处的断言不得进入正文
披露排除项：被考察后舍弃的材料同样列明并注明舍弃理由——审计者需要看到'没被采用的一切'
按语分轨：编者自己的判断以'按'字标出、与引文严格分行——事实与解释在排版层面不可混淆
使核检成本低于质疑成本：征考文档的组织让任何一个审计者的核检路径短于其质疑路径——透明度以'可走通'为标准
process_en: Attach a grounds list to every conclusion: conclusions and sources paired one-to-one ('plainly stating the basis') — claims without sources may not enter the main text
Disclose the exclusions: material examined and set aside is likewise listed with its reason — auditors must see everything not adopted
Separate the commentary track: the compiler's own judgment marked with an 'I note' and typeset apart from quotations — fact and interpretation unconfusable at the level of layout
Make checking cheaper than doubting: the document organized so any auditor's path of verification is shorter than the path of suspicion — transparency measured by walkability
representative_cases_zh: 《文献通考》的'按'字体例：马端临本人判断与引文在体例上严格分离——全书数百条按语均可独立核检
《经籍考》每书之下的引证规范：序跋评语逐条注明作者与出处
对杜佑、郑樵结论的逐条复核与明注：凡采其说者注明、凡改其说者说明理由
representative_cases_en: The 'I note' format throughout the Wenxian Tongkao: Ma Duanlin's own judgments typographically separated from quotations — hundreds of notes each independently checkable
The citation discipline of the Jingji Kao: every preface and evaluation attributed by author and source
Item-by-item re-examination of Du You's and Zheng Qiao's conclusions with explicit notes: adoption marked, amendment explained
modern_applications_zh: 数据科学模型卡的'决策日志'：特征选择、清洗与排除项全披露
学术论文的'预注册与补充材料'：排除的实验与分析全部列明
政府立法的'立法理由书'：每条的依据、反对意见与舍弃方案并列存档
modern_applications_en: Model cards and decision logs in data science: feature selection, cleaning and exclusions fully disclosed
Preregistration and supplementary materials in scholarship: excluded experiments and analyses all listed
Legislative rationale documents: each provision's grounds, objections and rejected alternatives archived side by side

modes.name_en: The Method of General and Sectional Prefaces
modes.domain_zh: 大规模知识体系需要导读层：总序说全部材料的来龙去脉，小序说每类的取舍标准与局限——原体系原封不动，导读层使陌生读者第一次有了地图——整理的最高形式不是重排，是引路
modes.domain_en: Large knowledge systems need a guiding layer: the general preface tells where all the material came from; each section's preface tells that class's selection standard and limits — the original system untouched, yet a stranger finally holds a map — the highest form of organizing is not rearranging but guiding
modes.definition_zh: 大规模知识体系需要导读层：总序说全部材料的来龙去脉，小序说每类的取舍标准与局限——原体系原封不动，导读层使陌生读者第一次有了地图——整理的最高形式不是重排，是引路
modes.definition_en: Large knowledge systems need a guiding layer: the general preface tells where all the material came from; each section's preface tells that class's selection standard and limits — the original system untouched, yet a stranger finally holds a map — the highest form of organizing is not rearranging but guiding
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡各门之首，必述其沿革大旨
modes.key_quote_en: 'At the head of each section, the general course of its subject is stated.'
process_zh: 先写总序：交代全部材料的来源、体例与取舍原则——总序回答'这是什么、为何如此组织'
每类配小序：该门类目的沿革大旨与材料的边界（收什么、不收什么、为什么）——小序回答'这一类里能找到什么、找不到什么'
不改动原体系：导读层叠加在既有结构之上而非重构结构——旧体系对老用户保持稳定，新读者获得入口
以'陌生读者测试'校准：让未接触体系的人仅凭总序小序回答'从哪找起'——导读的有效性以 stranger 可用为准
process_en: Write the general preface first: state the provenance of all material, the format and the selection principles — answering 'what is this and why is it organized thus'
Give each section a preface: the course of that topic's development and the boundary of its materials (what is taken, what not, and why) — answering 'what can and cannot be found here'
Leave the original system untouched: the guiding layer overlays the existing structure instead of rebuilding it — stability for old users, an entrance for new
Calibrate by the stranger test: someone new to the system answers 'where do I start' from the prefaces alone — a guide's validity is measured by stranger usability
representative_cases_zh: 《文献通考·自序》：全书三百四十八卷的总导读——马端临在自序中自述家学、体例、对杜佑郑樵的取舍与二十四门的立意
各门卷首的沿革小序：每门开头纵述该制度自上古至宋的演变大旨——读者入门先得全景再入细目
《经籍考》对每书的解题式导读：以'解题'体为每部文献配最小导读
representative_cases_en: The author's own preface: a general guide to all 348 juans — family learning, format, the stance toward Du You and Zheng Qiao, and the intent of the twenty-four sections
The sectional prefaces at each juan's head: a panorama of each institution's evolution from antiquity to Song before the fine detail
The jieti-style guides of the Jingji Kao: a minimal guide attached to each text
modern_applications_zh: 软件项目的 ARCHITECTURE.md 与 ADR 索引：不动代码而使新人可导航
博物馆的展线设计：总览层（时代地图）与分区解说（每厅小序）叠加于藏品之上
开源文档的'入门路径'：README 链接各子系统的'何时读这个'小序
modern_applications_en: ARCHITECTURE.md and ADR indexes in software projects: navigation for newcomers without touching the code
Museum exhibition design: overview layers (era maps) and hall-level guides layered above the collection
Onboarding paths in open-source docs: README linking each subsystem's 'when to read this' preface
